g.text: The MTU budget: why Docker needs the MTU option over Tailscale
Bar widths are to scale (1 px = 1.4 bytes). Tested: Docker defaults the overlay to 1450 regardless of the underlay.
A Docker default (no option): overlay MTU 1450
VXLAN overhead 50 = inner Eth 14 + VXLAN 8 + UDP 8 + outer IP 20
WireGuard overhead (up to 80): added BELOW tailscale0, so it is not subtracted from 1280
Rule of thumb: inner MTU = tailscale0 MTU - 50. Docker subtracts the 50 itself, so pass the UNDERLAY value (1280): `docker network create -d overlay --opt
(Passing 1230 gives 1180.) The default `ingress` network needs the same option.
